Smith Center]] |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2022–23 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team''' represented [[George Washington University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by first-year head coach [[Chris Caputo]], and played their home games at [[Charles E. Smith Center]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] as a member of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. The season marked the last for the school using the nickname Colonials.{{Cite web |last=Axson |first=Scooby |date=June 15, 2022 |title=George Washington University to stop using 'Colonials' name by 2023-24 |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/college/2022/06/15/george-washington-university-stop-using-colonials-name-2023-24/7635549001/ |access-date=2023-11-08 |website=USA Today |language=en-US}} On May 24, 2023, the school changed the nickname to Revolutionaries.{{Cite web |date=May 24, 2023 |title=It's Revolutionaries! |url=https://gwtoday.gwu.edu/its-revolutionaries |access-date=2023-11-08 |website=GW Today |language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|Colonials]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] with a 12–19 record and a 8–9 record in Atlantic 10 play.
